intro: To Gadgetzan You Go! is a journey undertaken by Horde cooks seeking to advance beyond the limits of their capital city instructors. Directed by Zamja in Orgrimmar, aspiring chefs travel south across Kalimdor to Tanaris to seek out the eccentric goblin butcher Dirge Quikcleave. This breadcrumb marks the transition into true mastery over the culinary arts.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: How you expect Zamja teach you anything? You got all of Zamja's cooking mojo and still you crave more!
Zamja can't help. Fat traveler needs to go to Gadgetzan. You find a little goblin named Dirge there - he help you, fatty.
When you become big cook on the block, you come back and teach Zamja, ok? Now go!

clips.title: Completion
paras: What? I'll have you know that leather is surprisingly high in protein and low in carbohydrates.
